messages:
Mara (PM): Quick pass — draft is in the doc. Need final CTAs, benchmark blurb, and webinar registration routing. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3...
Leo (Writer): On it. I'll trim the intro to 3 short paragraphs and add a benchmark callout.
Alex (Design): Do we have hero image? I can mock two variants for hero CTA left/right by EOD.
Sam (Growth): For routing: webinar registrants -> Marketo form A, blog leads -> SDR queue tag 'launch-APX'. Can we confirm?
Jen (Legal): Quick legal check — avoid claims about latency reductions unless we cite internal benchmark. Send the benchmark excerpt.
Mara (PM): Good catch Jen. Leo can you add a 1-sentence footnote: 'Based on internal tests, results may vary'?
Leo (Writer): Yep. Drafted: 'Internal benchmark: 40–60% inference cost per token reduction vs baseline*' then footnote added.
Jen (Legal): Change '40–60%' to 'up to 40–60%' and keep the '*' pointing to methodology doc. Also include a short methodology link.
Mara (PM): @Sam can you confirm tracking params? We want utm_source=blog, utm_campaign=orbit_launch, utm_content=hero_cta
Sam (Growth): Confirmed. Also recommend a mid-article CTA to the webinar (not just hero). I'll add link + registration UTM.
Alex (Design): Mock two hero CTAs and a mid-article banner. Will upload to the doc imgs folder: /marketing/assets/orbit-hero-v1.png
Leo (Writer): Small copy Q — hero CTA text options: 'See it in action' vs 'Register for webinar' — which converts better?
Sam (Growth): 'See it in action' better for early funnel, 'Register for webinar' better if you want attendees. Lean towards 'See it in action' for blog.
Mara (PM): Let's go 'See it in action' as hero and mid-article 'Register for webinar'. Ops to route registration -> webinar list + lead scoring tag.
ops-bot: deploy:publish-gate-checklist — hero image present, UTMs set, webinar form configured, Marketo mapping OK
Jen (Legal): Approved: wording updated per legal + methodology link included.
Mara (PM): Great. Leo please run one final sweep for claims + shorten intro. Alex please upload final hero. Sam — schedule email nudge to registrants 24h before webinar.
Leo (Writer): Final sweep done, pushed changes. Doc PR: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3...#changes
Alex (Design): Uploaded final hero: orbit-hero-v2.png :sparkles:
Sam (Growth): Email sequence scheduled. I'll drop the campaign id below once created.
Mara (PM): Approved to publish on Monday 10AM PT. Please flag if anything blocks. :rocket:
